title: Learning to Explain While Planning: Rule-Aligned Diffusion Planning for Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2609.39995v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion planners exhibit strong capabilities in generating multimodal trajectories. However, existing methods primarily rely on expert demonstrations to fit trajectory distributions, learning statistical correlations among scenes, behaviors, and trajectories without explicitly modeling driving rules. In long-tail scenarios where expert data are scarce, the lack of behaviors to imitate may lead to trajectories that violate safety or compliance requirements. Moreover, their generation process lacks rule-level explanations, making it difficult to determine which rules drive trajectory adjustments, when they take effect, and how strongly they act, thereby limiting failure diagnosis, safety validation, and targeted improvement. translated_title: 规划的同时学习解释：面向自动驾驶的规则对齐扩散规划
translated_abstract: 扩散规划器在生成多模态轨迹方面展现出强大的能力。然而，现有方法主要依赖专家演示来拟合轨迹分布，学习场景、行为与轨迹之间的统计相关性，而未显式地对驾驶规则进行建模。在专家数据稀缺的长尾场景中，缺乏可供模仿的行为可能导致生成违反安全性或合规性要求的轨迹。此外，这些方法的生成过程缺乏规则层面的解释，难以确定是哪些规则驱动了轨迹调整、规则何时生效以及作用强度有多大，从而限制了故障诊断、安全验证和针对性改进。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了规则对齐扩散规划器（RADP），在训练过程中将可微分的驾驶规则融入扩散目标函数，将规则知识转化为内在的
tldr: 提出规则对齐扩散规划器（RADP），通过在扩散训练目标中引入可微分驾驶规则，使自动驾驶规划器在专家数据稀缺的长尾场景下也能生成安全合规的轨迹，并提供规则层面的可解释性。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Rule-Aligned Diffusion Planner (RADP), which incorporates differentiable driving rules into the diffusion training objective, enabling safe and compliant trajectory generation in long-tail scenarios without relying on expert data, while providing rule-level explainability.
